title: Sam Altman deleted TikTok because he could not stop scrolling. OpenAI killed Sora for the same reason.

content_html:
TL;DR

Altman said he got “addicted” to TikTok while studying it for Sora. He deleted it after a 3-hour Saturday session. OpenAI killed Sora in March. The company says ChatGPT is designed not to trap users.

Sam Altman deleted TikTok because he could not stop using it. The OpenAI CEO said on the “Relentless” podcast that he forced himself to learn the app while OpenAI was building Sora, its AI-generated video social network. “I made myself get addicted to TikTok, because I wanted to just learn,” he said. He started with 10 minutes before bed. Then it was an hour. Then it was three hours on a Saturday afternoon. “I was really enjoying it in the moment like a drug,” he said. He deleted the app.

OpenAI deleted Sora too. The company scrapped the app in March after roughly six months, deciding that video generation consumed too much compute at a time when Anthropic and other competitors were pushing the frontier AI race further. Sora had attracted a Disney partnership and significant attention, but the economics did not work. The parallel is hard to miss: Altman found TikTok too consuming to keep, and OpenAI found Sora too consuming to sustain.

Altman discussed the experience in the context of the Jony Ive AI device, which OpenAI has said it will unveil before the end of the year. Altman has said he wants the device to cut through the notification noise that makes phones feel like “walking through Times Square.” Google rebuilt Search around AI summaries to keep users inside its ecosystem longer. Altman is arguing OpenAI should do the opposite: build a product people use briefly and leave. “Instead of measuring success by time spent or clicks, we care more about whether you leave the product having done what you came for,” OpenAI said last August.

The admission is revealing because it comes from the person building the AI systems that power the next generation of recommendation algorithms. Altman experienced firsthand that TikTok’s algorithm is, in his words, “too powerful,” and that even someone who understood exactly what was happening could not resist it. Wharton researchers found that people accept AI outputs 80% of the time, even when wrong. TikTok’s algorithm is not wrong. It is precisely right about what keeps you watching. The CEO of the world’s most valuable AI company could not outsmart it. That is the most honest product review TikTok has ever received.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Altman 表示，他在为 Sora 研究 TikTok 时对 TikTok“上瘾”了。 他在周六 3 小时的会议后删除了它。 OpenAI 在三月份杀死了 Sora。 该公司表示 ChatGPT 的设计目的不是为了诱骗用户。

萨姆·奥尔特曼删除了 TikTok，因为他无法停止使用它。 OpenAI 首席执行官在“Relentless”播客中表示，他在 OpenAI 构建 AI 生成的视频社交网络 Sora 时强迫自己学习该应用程序。 “我让自己对 TikTok 上瘾，因为我只是想学习，”他说。 他从睡前 10 分钟开始。 然后就是一个小时了。 然后是星期六下午的三个小时。 “那一刻我真的很享受它，就像吸毒一样，”他说。 他删除了该应用程序。

OpenAI 也删除了 Sora。 该公司在大约六个月后于 3 月份废弃了该应用程序，认为在 Anthropic 和其他竞争对手进一步推动前沿人工智能竞赛之际，视频生成消耗了太多计算资源。 索拉吸引了迪士尼的合作伙伴和极大的关注，但经济效益并不奏效。 相似之处不容忽视：Altman 发现 TikTok 太耗电而无法维持，而 OpenAI 则发现 Sora 太耗电而无法维持。

Altman 讨论了 Jony Ive AI 设备的体验，OpenAI 表示将在今年年底前推出该设备。 奥特曼表示，他希望该设备能够消除通知噪音，让手机感觉就像“走过时代广场”。 谷歌围绕人工智能摘要重建了搜索，以使用户更长时间地留在其生态系统中。 Altman 认为 OpenAI 应该做相反的事情：构建一个人们短暂使用的产品然后离开。 OpenAI 去年 8 月表示：“我们不是通过花费的时间或点击次数来衡量成功，而是更关心你是否让产品完成了你想要的事情。”

这一承认具有启发性，因为它来自于构建为下一代推荐算法提供动力的人工智能系统的人。 奥特曼亲身体验到，用他的话说，TikTok 的算法“太强大了”，即使是真正了解发生了什么的人也无法抗拒。 沃顿商学院的研究人员发现，80% 的时间人们都会接受人工智能的输出，即使是错误的。 TikTok的算法并没有错。 这正是让你持续关注的原因。 世界上最有价值的人工智能公司的首席执行官无法比它聪明。 这是 TikTok 收到的最诚实的产品评论。
